verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's marketing says you can compute your bill yourself before contacting sales and compare it one-to-one with your current managed ClickHouse spend. It also documents a free dev tier with stated limits (up to 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, no credit card) and offers a free cost audit. However, the pack contains no actual price rates, billing units or calculator details, so it is unproven that a workload's monthly bill can really be estimated from the documentation. Missing for 10: published per-unit pricing (compute, storage, egress), documented billing dimensions for paid tiers, evidence of how the bill calculator works, independent or hands-on confirmation that estimates match real bills.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, the pricing model is documented clearly enough that I can estimate a monthly bill for my workload before committing
